champion.tips: ILLAOI TIPS AND TRICKS Illaoi’s Q is a great poke tool and is great for wave control too. However, it is slightly more expensive than her W . If you can, try and use a terrain Tentacle instead of your Q to trade with the enemy. Essentially, they will do the same job at the cost of less mana! Take advantage of your W auto-attack reset by (when applicable) walking up to the enemy, auto-attacking once and then using your W . Illaoi’s Ultimate R has a brief moment of unstoppability at the beginning. This can be used to dodge critical crowd control that would otherwise limit your damage potential.
champion.builds: THE BEST ILLAOI BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Illaoi Top build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, followed by Demolish, Bone Plating and Overgrowth in the primary tree, as well as Last Stand and Presence of Mind in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Iceborn Gauntlet as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Black Cleaver. For your last 3 items, you should build Sterak's Gage, Spirit Visage and finish with Thornmail. For the skill order, you want to stick with E - Q - W. Right now, this build has 51.0% winrate over 2 531 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Conqueror as your keystone, Presence of Mind, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Demolish in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Black Cleaver as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Iceborn Gauntlet as a third item. You want to finish the build with Sterak's Gage, Spirit Visage and Thornmail. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it E - Q - W. This build is currently sitting at a 49.1% win rate across 1 002 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Illaoi Top build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, Grasp of the Undying, Demolish, Bone Plating and Overgrowth as your primary rune tree, and Last Stand with Presence of Mind as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Sundered Sky as your first item, then finish Plated Steelcaps as your second item, and Sterak's Gage as third item. The last 3 options are Iceborn Gauntlet, Spirit Visage and Death's Dance. The ability order for this build is E - Q - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 56.3% win rate over 529 matches played. Situational Illaoi Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Illaoi build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Illaoi runes page.
